```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

library(here)
```

##Pull in metadata
```{r metadata}

##Metadata
meta <- read.csv("../Raw_Data/202407/COMPASS_SynopticCB_LatT_GCW_Discrete_Metadata.csv")
colnames(meta)

##Sensor data
sensor <- read.csv("../Raw_Data/202407/GCReW_SurfaceWater_1hr_Sensor_Data.csv")
colnames(sensor)
sensor1 <- sensor %>% 
  select(datetime_1hr, Specific_Conductivity_uScm_mean, Salinity_PPT_mean, Temp_C_mean) %>% 
  mutate(datetime_1hr = as_datetime(datetime_1hr, tz = "America/New_York"), 
         datetime_1hr = format(datetime_1hr, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) 

##Combine sensor data with metadata
meta1 <- meta %>% 
  mutate(date = mdy(date), 
         date1 = case_when(
           time_sampled_est == "23:00" & time_sampled_edt == "0:00" ~ date + days(1), 
           time_sampled_est == "0:00" & time_sampled_edt == "1:00" ~ date + days(1), 
           TRUE ~ date
         )) %>% 
  
  mutate(
         datetime = paste0 (date1, " ", time_sampled_edt),
         datetime = ymd_hm(datetime, tz = "America/New_York"),
         datetime_1hr = round_date(datetime, unit = "hour"),
         datetime_1hr = format(datetime_1hr, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) 
  

dat <- left_join(meta1, sensor1, by = "datetime_1hr")


dat1 <- dat %>% 
  mutate(
         spc = ifelse(is.na(gw_conductivity_mScm), Specific_Conductivity_uScm_mean, gw_conductivity_mScm*1000), 
         sal_ppt = ifelse(is.na(gw_salinity_ppt), Salinity_PPT_mean, gw_salinity_ppt), 
         h2o_temp_c = ifelse(is.na(gw_temp_c), Temp_C_mean, gw_temp_c)) %>% 
  
  rename(sample_name = sample_id, 
         notes = Notes, 
         sample_datetime = datetime) %>% 
  mutate(notes = ifelse(sample_type == "EST" , "Rhode River Estuary (SERC Dock)", notes)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = ifelse(sample_type == "EST" , "SW", sample_type)) %>% 
  mutate(location = "Marsh_weir", 
         sample_id = NA, 
         old_sample_id = NA, 
         pco2_datetime = NA, 
         pco2_id = NA, 
         xco2_ppm = NA, 
         do_ysi_perc = NA, 
         do_ysi_mg_l = NA, 
         ph_ysi_nbs = NA, 
         dic_taken = "1", 
         alk_umol_kgsw_avg = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_sd = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_se = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_cv = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_avg = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_sd = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_se = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_cv = NA, 
         alk_v_crm_umol_kgsw = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_percerr_crm = NA, 
         lat = NA, 
         lon = NA, 
         created = NA, 
         updated = NA
) %>% 
  select(sample_id, old_sample_id, location, sample_type, sample_name, sample_datetime, pco2_datetime, pco2_id, xco2_ppm, spc, sal_ppt, h2o_temp_c, do_ysi_perc, do_ysi_mg_l, ph_ysi_nbs, dic_taken, notes, alk_umol_kgsw_avg, alk_umol_kgsw_sd, alk_umol_kgsw_se, alk_umol_kgsw_cv, alk_mmol_l_avg, alk_mmol_l_sd, alk_mmol_l_se, alk_mmol_l_cv, alk_v_crm_umol_kgsw, alk_umol_kgsw_percerr_crm, lat, lon, created, updated)

write.csv(dat1, "../Raw_Data/202407/COMPASS_SynopticCB_LatT_GCW_Discrete_Metadata_FORMATTED.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
